# Biology Online

> > A comprehensive online biology resource offering thousands of dictionary definitions, in-depth articles, and interactive tutorials across all major biology disciplines.

Biology Online is a leading educational platform providing accessible biology content including a specialized dictionary with 5,000+ terms, extensive articles covering genetics, molecular biology, ecology, and medicine, and structured learning tutorials. The site serves students, educators, and biology enthusiasts seeking reliable, well-organized biological knowledge.

## Key Topics

- Biology Dictionary
- Evolutionary Biology
- Cell Biology
- Cellular Processes
- Plant Biology
- Ecology
- Genetics
- Molecular Biology
- Convergent Evolution
- Analogous Structures
- ATP
- Amino Acids
- Glycolysis
- Educational Content
- Online Learning

## Core Resources

- [Learn Biology Online - Biology Articles, Tutorials & Dictionary Online](https://www.biologyonline.com): Homepage for Biology Online, comprehensive biology resource database
- [Biology Dictionary Online | BiologyOnline.com](https://www.biologyonline.com/dictionary): Main Biology Dictionary product with thousands of term definitions
- [Biology Articles - Biology Articles, Tutorials & Dictionary Online](https://www.biologyonline.com/articles): 5,000+ biology articles on genetics, molecular biology, ecology, medicine
- [Biology Tutorials - Biology Articles, Tutorials & Dictionary Online](https://www.biologyonline.com/tutorials): Learning tutorials covering plant biology, physiology, ecology, development

## Dictionary - Evolutionary Biology & Ecology

- [Adaptation - Definition and Examples - Biology Online Dictionary](https://www.biologyonline.com/dictionary/adaptation): Dictionary entry on adaptation, evolutionary traits, and natural selection
- [Allopatric speciation - Definition and Examples - Biology Online Dictionary](https://www.biologyonline.com/dictionary/allopatric-speciation): Dictionary entry on allopatric speciation and evolutionary species formation
- [Analogous - Definition and Examples - Biology Online Dictionary](https://www.biologyonline.com/dictionary/analogous): Dictionary entry on analogous structures and convergent evolution
- [Analogous structures - Definition and Examples | Biology Online](https://www.biologyonline.com/dictionary/analogous-structures): Definition of analogous structures with convergent evolution examples
- [Abiotic Definition and Examples - Biology Online Dictionary](https://www.biologyonline.com/dictionary/abiotic): Dictionary entry defining abiotic factors in ecosystems with examples

## Dictionary - Cellular Biology & Biochemistry

- [Active transport - Definition and Examples - Biology Online Dictionary](https://www.biologyonline.com/dictionary/active-transport): Definition and examples of active transport with ATP and cellular processes
- [Aerobic bacteria - Definition and Examples - Biology Online Dictionary](https://www.biologyonline.com/dictionary/aerobic-bacteria): Reference on aerobic bacteria, respiration, and microbiology definitions
- [Amphipathic - Definition and Examples - Biology Online Dictionary](https://www.biologyonline.com/dictionary/amphipathic): Definition of amphipathic molecules and phospholipid cell membranes
- [Anabolism - Definition and Examples - Biology Online Dictionary](https://www.biologyonline.com/dictionary/anabolism): Dictionary entry on anabolism, metabolism, and biochemical synthesis
- [Anaerobic - Definition and Examples - Biology Online Dictionary](https://www.biologyonline.com/dictionary/anaerobic): Definition of anaerobic organisms and processes without molecular oxygen
- [What is Anaerobic Respiration? The Definitive Guide - Biology Online](https://www.biologyonline.com/dictionary/anaerobic-respiration): Comprehensive guide on anaerobic respiration, fermentation, and energy

## Dictionary - Genetics & Anatomy

- [Allele - Definition and Examples - Biology Online Dictionary](https://www.biologyonline.com/dictionary/allele): Definition of alleles, gene variants, and Mendelian inheritance patterns
- [Angiosperm - Definition and Examples - Biology Online Dictionary](https://www.biologyonline.com/dictionary/angiosperm): Comprehensive entry on angiosperms, flowering plants, and taxonomy
- [Animal - Definition and Examples - Biology Online Dictionary](https://www.biologyonline.com/dictionary/animal): Dictionary entry defining animals, Kingdom Animalia, and characteristics
- [Alimentary canal - Definition and Examples - Biology Online Dictionary](https://www.biologyonline.com/dictionary/alimentary-canal): Dictionary entry on alimentary canal anatomy and digestive system
- [Anatomy - Definition and Examples - Biology Online Dictionary](https://www.biologyonline.com/dictionary/anatomy): Dictionary entry on anatomy, body structure, and anatomical branches
